name: JoeFest
blurb: A toy and comic convention in Augusta, Georgia, with over 250 vendors, comic creators and pop-culture guests.

editions.evidence: Homepage banner: 'JoeFest Toy and Comic Convention June 25-27, 2027 AUGUSTA, GEORGIA Augusta Marriott at the Convention Center' with address line 'AUGUSTA CONVENTION CENTER 901 REYNOLDS STREET AUGUSTA, GEORGIA 30901'; a WFXG news article and independenttoys.news both confirm June 25-27, 2027 at the Augusta Convention Center.

notes: The homepage still carries a lot of leftover copy about the prior June 26-28, 2026 edition (which has already happened), including a guest mention ('BRIAN WILK... welcome to 2026 Augusta Toy and Comic Convention') and a Talking Joe Podcast appearance, but the top banner and page title clearly point to the next edition, June 25-27, 2027, and the venue address matches the Augusta Convention Center confirmed by a WFXG article and independenttoys.news. The Guests and Vendors page (https://www.joefestusa.com/guests-and-vendors) currently shows no guest cards at all for 2027, so guests is 'none-yet'. No organizer company name was found on the site or in search results, so left blank rather than guessed.
